annotations.text: DEFAULT — Sticker Sheet. Die-cut stickers (white border, faint ring, soft shadow, slight seeded tilt), icon-bubbles on a plan-vs-actual donut, candy jar fills. The coach uses the Paper Ledger margin-note: legal-pad paper, hard offset shadow, tape, handwritten face — a real note pinned onto the sheet.

CALM MODE — for motion sensitivity / low vision. No tilt, no gloss, no page texture; separation by a solid 2px ink ring instead of shadow. Bigger, heavier text. Taller bordered progress bars. Donut static with numeric labels. Coach note keeps the paper look but a legible face. Auto-on with prefers-reduced-motion / prefers-contrast, plus a manual toggle.

COLOUR-BLIND SAFE — Okabe–Ito jar palette, and every jar also carries a fixed pattern + icon + text label + numeric %. Donut segments get bg-colour dividers and a leader-line legend. State shown with ✓ / ⚠ glyphs, never colour alone. Independent toggle — combines with Calm and Dark.

DARK MODE — warm eggplant base, not slate. Stickers become raised dark surfaces with a hue left-edge and a hue-tinted icon chip; fills are never flooded. Jar hues lightened ~10% so they don't vibrate on dark. Coach note becomes aged paper. Follows prefers-color-scheme + toggle.

The system behind the four screens: type ramp, colour roles (light + dark), both jar palettes, the sticker and coach-note recipes, and the accessibility-mode matrix. The full written spec lives at docs/DESIGN-STICKER-SHEET.md in the repo.
